name: alloflow-pdf-remediation
description: Rebuild attached PDFs for accessibility in the active file sandbox with no paid Worker, institution account, or separate API key.

interface.shortDescription: Remediate PDFs with no extra account or API key.
interface.longDescription: Rebuild attached PDFs as accessible HTML and, when local capabilities permit, a tagged PDF plus a scoped verification report without a paid Worker, institution account, AlloFlow service, or separate model API key.
defaultPrompt: Remediate the attached PDF for accessibility and return the rebuilt copy and scoped report.
